description:
Mainframe Developer 
 Req number: 
R8568 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Remote 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are seeking an experienced Mainframe Developer with advanced expertise in COBOL, JCL, and NATURAL, and working knowledge of ADABAS 
 Job Description 
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Mainframe Developer to join our IT team. This position will be full-time, remote, and is a contract position.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Develop, enhance, and maintain COBOL , NATURAL , and JCL programs supporting multiple client projects

 Work on multiple legacy mainframe applications and integration efforts involving taxation and client systems

 Analyze existing mainframe applications and provide code walkthroughs, technical analysis, and documentation to support modernization teams.

 Design, code, test, implement, and maintain new and existing batch and online mainframe applications

 Troubleshoot production issues, job failures, and system abends; perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions

 Analyze and support ADABAS databases, file structures, and data access methods

 Develop and maintain data feeds, interfaces, file layouts, and integration processes between legacy systems and modernized platforms

 Participate in system design reviews, technical planning sessions, and code reviews

 Create and maintain technical documentation including program specifications, job flows, system architecture diagrams, and data definitions

 Support system testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production deployments

 
 
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 5+ years of experience developing enterprise mainframe applications using COBOL

 5+ years of experience with JCL development and job scheduling.

 3+ years of experience with NATURAL/ADABAS

 5+ years of experience using TSO/ISPF or similar mainframe editing tools

 3+ years of experience with AFP, PAGEDEF, FORMDEF, and OVERLAY technologies

 Advanced expertise in COBOL, JCL, and NATURAL programming

 Working knowledge of ADABAS database architecture and file structures

 Experience maintaining and enhancing large legacy mainframe systems

 Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills for batch and online applications

 Experience developing system integrations, data interfaces, file transfers, and data feeds

 Ability to analyze technical specifications, system workflows, and data models

 Experience with mainframe utilities, job monitoring tools, and debugging tools

 
 Preferred:
 Experience supporting taxation, revenue, or government systems

 Familiarity with CICS and online transaction processing environments

 Experience with legacy modernization or data migration initiatives

 Knowledge of mainframe security, scheduling tools, and source code management practices

 
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards 

 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc. 

 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor 

 
 Reasonable accommodation statement 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.

This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.
